meta.note: Which components have a Claude Design artboard, and what that artboard actually covers. This is the ONE column of plan/design-status.md that cannot be derived from the repo — Claude Design lives outside it, so this registry is hand-maintained. Keep `covers` honest: a component that appears as a small fragment inside a study is NOT designed, and saying so is the point of the file.

redesignPhase.note: The library is being redesigned in Claude Design and transferred to Figma afterwards (tasks/atelier-design-system-plan.md, Phase 3). While this is true, Figma is the TARGET of the transfer, not the reference for it: the masters are stale by definition until they are rebuilt. So check:parity reports an inputsHash drift as a WARNING rather than a BLOCKER — re-verifying against a design we have deliberately left behind proves nothing. Every drifted record still has to be re-verified once the transfer lands. Set active:false then, and the gate blocks again.
redesignPhase.clearedBy: Phase 3: rebuild the Figma masters from the redesign, then re-verify + parity:record every component.

meta.sharedStylesheet: _sheet.css — the sheet chrome and the specimen primitives every form field shares (field recipe, panel, option row, adornment, state modifiers). Each AtlXxx.dc.html links it and keeps only what is specific to that component, so a change to the chrome is one edit rather than one per sheet. Its palette is a deliberate copy of the light-mode tokens: an artboard renders standalone in Claude Design, where the library's tokens.css is not loaded.

artboards.subject: typography
artboards.note: Turn 1 compares three type directions, turn 2 three readings of "bolder" on the chosen pair. Decided ADR-0035 / ADR-0036. The button row, input field and mini card inside each option card are specimens sized to show type — not component designs, and deliberately not counted as coverage.

artboards.subject: AtlButton
artboards.note: Variant x size matrix (the default-state slice, 12 of the master's 24), all states at size=md with the four variant states separated from the disabled/loading Booleans, an anatomy table naming the token behind every value, and findings. Corrected 2026-08-26: disabled/loading are Figma Booleans not code-only props, the 24 variants are a deliberate two-slice cross rather than half a 4x3x4 matrix, and the anatomy reflects ADR-0041 (heights exact at 32/40/48, block padding derived).

artboards.subject: AtlCombobox
artboards.note: Eight specimens: the six Figma variant states (open/filtered/selected each drawn with their panel), the no-results state that has no Figma variant, and the invalid and readonly cases. Records that readonly exists in the code but not on the master, so the transfer has to add the Boolean.

artboards.subject: AtlInput
artboards.note: Eight states (the five Figma variant states plus the disabled/readonly Booleans and invalid+focus), a measured anatomy table, and findings. Rewritten 2026-08-26 after ADRs 0043-0049 turned three of its open findings into fixed ones: readonly now has a visual treatment, the invalid indicator is an AtlIcon instance rather than a literal glyph, and the border width has a token. Now links the shared _sheet.css.

artboards.subject: AtlSelect
artboards.note: Seven specimens: the five Figma variant states (default | filled | hover | focus | open, the open one drawn with its panel and option states) plus the invalid and disabled Booleans. Measured anatomy. Findings include two open cross-component questions this sheet surfaced: invalid is carried by border colour alone here and in AtlCombobox while AtlInput and AtlTextarea draw an indicator, and an option row is 36px here against AtlCombobox's 40.

artboards.subject: AtlTextarea
artboards.note: Eight specimens: the five Figma variant states plus the readonly, disabled and autoResize Booleans. States explicitly that this is the one control that keeps the prose line-height (1.5) and whose height is content-driven by design, so the difference from every other control reads as a decision rather than as drift.
